reviews.title: Sturdy sharp blades
reviews.review_text: Sturdy, good capacity, and sharp blades. Lots of attachments perhaps too many. Our old GE broke and replaced it with updated one hoping for same long quality.

reviews.review_text: It lost a star when I discovered that the small bowl still has to nestle inside the larger bowl in order to be used. Really liked the smaller bowl in my old food processor as I could avoid washing unnecessary pieces when I was doing a small job. Not with this design.

reviews.title: Feature-Rich GE Food Processor with Durability Con
reviews.review_text: I recently acquired the GE food processor, and while its array of accessories and parts impressed me, there are some durability concerns that give me pause. The device boasts a variety of functions and the metal cutting blades are robust, but the plastic gears within raise doubts about its long-term reliability. Despite this, it seems well-suited for our family's needs, offering versatility and convenience. However, only time will tell if it stands the test of frequent use.

reviews.title: It just a name
reviews.review_text: For YEARS I've wanted a certain “brand name” kitchen appliance. In red. I insisted that other brands just wouldn't work as well. I was wrong! This baby meets all of our cooking/baking needs!

reviews.title: Maximum utility
reviews.review_text: With all the accessories AND the mini bowl, is there anything this machine can't do??? My only complaint would be the loading shute is no quite large enough to fit a whole potato when slicing for scalloped potatoes.

reviews.title: I would rate this a 3.5 out of 5
reviews.review_text: This processor is much quieter than my last one. However, when I use the shredding blades, the blades do no fit the opening and unshredded food falls into the shredded. I have to get it out. Sometimes a lot of unshredded food.
